title: Secure TaskFlow End to End
goal: Add Supabase identity, verify tokens in NestJS, and enforce roles, permissions, ownership, and tenant isolation on the API.
steps: Complete sign-up/sign-in and inspect the returned session.
Send an access token as a bearer token to the API.
Verify signature/issuer/audience/expiry before constructing current-user context.
Protect routes with a NestJS guard.
Return 401 for unusable authentication and 403 for valid identity without permission.
Add role/permission checks for one action.
Load the target task and enforce ownership/workspace membership server-side.
Perform an IDOR test by changing a task id while using another valid user token.
Add regression tests proving cross-tenant reads/writes stay forbidden.
evidence: A clean Git diff or file-tree change
Browser, HTTP, database, test, container, or CI evidence that proves the behavior
One deliberate failure, the evidence you used, and the root-cause fix
A short explanation of why the final responsibility lives in the chosen layer
completion: I can reproduce one key part without the walkthrough.
I can explain one trade-off I deliberately chose.
I can show one failure that my tests, constraints, or runbook now protects against.
